# Business case (one page)

Write for the person who funds the work. Every number carries its unit, its period and its source. Mark guesses as guesses.

Title: the investment in one line. Author: a person. Date: YYYY-MM-DD.

## Problem

Two or three sentences. What it costs today, in money or hours per month, and how you know (a log, an invoice, a count).

## Options

Always at least three: do nothing, the option you recommend, and one alternative (buy, wait or a smaller step). One line each.

## The money for each option

| | Do nothing | Recommended | Alternative |
|---|---|---|---|
| Upfront cost | | | |
| Yearly running cost (people, infrastructure, model spend) | | | |
| Exit cost (what leaving costs in year 3) | | | |
| Yearly benefit | | | |
| Total over 3 years | | | |
| NPV at the company's discount rate (low / likely / high) | | | |
| Payback month (low / likely / high) | | | |

Give each uncertain number as a range. State the discount rate and who set it.

## Cost of delay

What one month of waiting costs, and how that ranks this work against the other items waiting (cost of delay divided by duration).

## Risk

The three things that would make the numbers wrong, how each would show up early, and what you would do then. Name the reversibility: what is the cheapest point at which we can stop?

## Decision asked for

One sentence: "Approve X, with budget Y, by date Z." Then the date after which the answer costs money, and what you will report at the first checkpoint.
